questions.q: Why did Quraysh leave the Prophet SAW alone for 40 years but oppose him later?
options: Because he began to challenge the system, not just rituals
questions.explain: Criticise the system, not only the rituals.

questions.q: What small share of steadfast people is enough for change, according to this lecture?
questions.explain: Change can happen with about two percent who are ready to sacrifice.

questions.q: What does mudhammam, Ummu Jamil's name for Muhammad, mean?
questions.explain: Muhammad means praised; mudhammam is a mockery.

questions.q: What is the advice about independence of soul and identity?
options: Be proud of our own language, food and culture
questions.explain: Do not measure yourself by the coloniser.

questions.q: What did the companions do to show their longing for the Prophet SAW?
options: Spread across the world, not just weep at the grave
questions.explain: Longing for the Prophet SAW needs action.

questions.q: Defending one's own ethnic group is always wrong in Islam.
questions.explain: False. Defending is not wrong, but despising others and breeding enmity is jahili.

questions.q: Riba widens the gap between rich and poor, unlike zakat which closes it.
Put these events in the right order.

items.text: The sun in my right hand
The Prophet SAW calls "Say La ilaha illallah"
The elite council demands he be stopped
Uthman, Abu Bakr and Talha are bound

questions.explain: He called out, filth and thorns, companions bound, the elite demanded, then the "sun in my right hand" reply.

questions.q: Match each term with its meaning.

right.text: Small aid withheld by the stingy
Interest that widens the gap between rich and poor
The sea silk route from the east to Arabia

questions.explain: Muhaddithat are women narrators, the Maritime Silk Road is a sea route, riba widens the gap, and Al-Ma'un is small aid.

questions.q: You see poverty all around. What is the Prophet's SAW example?
options: Wait for the structure to change
Help first while challenging the structure
questions.explain: Do not wait for the structure to be fixed before helping.
